name: First-order Spherical Harmonics Distillation
definition: A technique to distill first-order Spherical Harmonic (SH) parameters under the guidance of a pretrained teacher model, reducing storage burden and increasing rendering speed compared to the original third-order SH.
summary: First-order Spherical Harmonics Distillation reduces 3D Gaussian Splatting parameters by using knowledge distillation to preserve rendering quality, unlike standard truncation.
